```yaml
name: Publish Connectors Pre‑Release (Slash Command)

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      pr-number:
        description: 'Pull request number to comment on'
        required: true
        type: string

jobs:
  start:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Post start comment
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa
        with:
          message: |
            :rocket: Starting pre‑release publish of modified connectors.
            Expected image tags will include `-dev.${{ github.sha }}`.
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          pr-number: ${{ inputs.pr-number }}
          comment-tag: publish-connectors-prerelease-start
          mode: create

  publish:
    needs: start
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
      actions: read
    steps:
      - name: Call publish_connectors.yml
        uses: ./.github/workflows/publish_connectors.yml
        with:
          release-type: pre-release
          modified: true

  finish:
    needs: publish
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: always()
    permissions:
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Post completion comment
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa
        with:
          message: |
            ${{ job.status == 'success' && ':white_check_mark:' || ':x:' }} Pre‑release publish ${{
            job.status == 'success' && 'succeeded' || 'failed' }}.
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          pr-number: ${{ inputs.pr-number }}
          comment-tag: publish-connectors-prerelease-complete
          mode: create
```
